_comment: HARDEN-007 tenant-authz grandfathered debt. New routes NOT on this list that access tenant data without an approved authorization call fail CI. Fix a route (add enforceCompanyAccess/requireCapability/etc. or a documented `// authz-ok:` comment) then delete it here. Routes that are INTENTIONALLY PUBLIC are no longer carried here: they are classified PUBLIC-CERTIFIED by the detector when their policy declaration passes the check-route-policy public validator (V-1/8/9/10, DRIFT-1, PUB-DRIFT-1..4, CONTRACT-DRIFT-1). A public route that fails any of those is a PUBLIC-VIOLATION and fails the build. Everything still listed here is genuinely unaudited.
